svg.title: SpotClicker USB perfboard MVP wiring and compact layout
svg.desc: Top and mirrored solder-side views of a five-column by six-row perfboard. The USB 3V3 supply connects through a removable link to the motor positive and diode cathode. The CHERRY keyboard switch connects XIAO D1 to ground. Spare battery pads permit a later upgrade.

g.text: CHERRY keyboard switch · XIAO nRF52840 · FIT0774 motor · battery pads reserved
Flip left-to-right. Keep row 1 at top.
Side-by-side modules with the perfboard below the key
Q1 flat face points toward row 5.
B1–C1 is the removable USB motor link.
USB plug and enclosure walls need their own clearance.
Leave the XIAO underside and source link accessible.
PB coordinates refer to the perfboard shown above.
PB A3 · R1 to Q1 base
Every listed pair needs a wire. Perfboard pads are isolated.
B1–C1 connects 3V3 to the motor supply.
Use the reserved pads for the protected pack and slide switch.
Keep B1–C1 for the first battery trial. Add switched pack + to PB D1, XIAO BAT+ to PB E1, and pack − to PB D6.
If portable measurements call for direct motor power, move the link to C1–D1 after implementing the battery firmware.
USB build uses the 3V3 link only. Keep the battery pads empty during this build.
